summary: Pan repeatedly declined to say whether Israel committed genocide in an August 2026 debate, affirming that Israel 'has a right to exist and to defend itself' while pivoting to the humanitarian crisis. CAIR Action lists him as preferred, not endorsed. 314 Action Fund, which received UDP funding in 2024, spent roughly $1.2 million in independent support. His September post on the Iran War signals opposition to U.S. military action in the region, but his Gaza remarks stop short of blaming Israel.
